feeds.title: Refugee Action Blog
feeds.description: At Refugee Action, we've spent 35 years helping refugees build safe, hopeful and productive new lives in the UK. We get them the basic support they need to live again with dignity. Our vision is that refugees and asylum seekers will be welcome in the UK.

feeds.title: Women for Refugee Women Blog
feeds.description: Supporting refugee women to rebuild their lives with dignity. Women for Refugee Women challenges the injustices experienced by women and children who seek refuge in the UK. We aim to enable women and children seeking asylum in the UK to tell their own stories. We believe they deserve to be heard!

feeds.title: RISE | Refugees Survivours and Ex-detainees Blog
feeds.description: RISE is the first welfare and advocacy organisation governed entirely by Refugees, Asylum seekers and Ex-detainees in Australia. Our work revolves around our Advocacy Program where we act on our members behalf to improve government and non-governments policies and in an attempt to generate positive social change for our communities.

feeds.title: Refugee Law Initiative Blog
feeds.description: The Refugee Law Initiative is the only academic center in the UK to concentrate specifically on international refugee law. As a national focal point for leading and promoting research in this field, RLI works to integrate the shared interests of refugee law scholars and practitioners, stimulate collaboration between academics and non-academics, and achieve policy impact at the national and international levels. Visit the RLI blog on Refugee Law and Forced Migration.

feeds.title: Scottish Refugee Council | Building a better future with refugees in Scotland
feeds.description: Scottish Refugee Council is an independent charity working to build a better future with refugees and asylum seekers in Scotland. It provides asylum support and advice, information and support to refugees and asylum seekers.

feeds.title: Refugee Research Network
feeds.description: The Refugee Research Network (RRN) has been created to mobilize and sustain a Canadian and international network of researchers and research centres committed to the study of refugee and forced migration issues and to engaging policy makers and practitioners in finding solutions to the plight of refugees and displaced persons.

feeds.title: Refugees International Japan | Helping people rebuild their lives and restoring human dignity
feeds.description: Refugees International Japan is an independent, not-for-profit organization dedicated to raising funds to assist refugees who have lost everything as a result of war and conflict. Operating out of Tokyo, we are staffed by volunteers from the Japanese and international communities. Refugees International Japan channels project funds through experienced organizations already working with refugees out in the field, ensuring that assistance goes quickly and directly to where it is most needed.

feeds.title: The Ripple Refugee Project
feeds.description: The Ripple Refugee Project is a Toronto-based private refugee sponsorship group that was founded in May 2015 with the goal of sponsoring refugees to come to Canada, to share lessons learned about private sponsorship and to do advocacy work around Canada's refugee response. This is a forum where members and followers of the group can post updates and discuss various issues related to the sponsorship of refugees.

feeds.title: United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees
feeds.description: UNHCR, the UN Refugee Agency, is a global organisation dedicated to saving lives, protecting rights and building a better future for refugees, forcibly displaced communities and stateless people. They work to ensure that everybody has the right to seek asylum and find safe refuge, having fled violence, persecution, war or disaster at home.

feeds.title: Refugees Deeply | Refugee crisis news & migration issues coverage
feeds.description: The mission of Refugees Deeply is to provide our users and expert community with a deeper and more complete understanding of refugee crises around the world. Follow to keep up with In-depth coverage of the global refugee crisis and forced migration, featuring reporting, analysis, expert interviews and commentary.

feeds.title: Refugee Support
feeds.description: We aim to improve the livelihoods and outcomes of refugees by prioritizing dignity and co-operation. We believe that if we are going to achieve that we need to adhere to high professional and ethical standards.
